name: Moeru Shinku no Tsuki ni
source:
Main character witnesses a woman illuminated by scarlet moonlight standing in the classroom.
"You're the only one I won't kill". So says the girl and atmosphere of madness starts to cling to the protagonist...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角目睹一名被猩红月光照亮的女子站在教室里。

“唯独你，我不会杀。”女孩如此说道，疯狂的气息开始缠上主角……

（来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]）
